title: Inventor Mk II

featTraits.innovation: An innovation's level is equal to your level. If your innovation is lost or destroyed, you can rebuild it the next time you make your daily preparations. An innovation only works due to your constant maintenance and tinkering, and therefore has no market Price.

description: An updated alternate take on the Inventor class for Pathfinder Second Edition that reworks their chassis and the unstable trait, with the aim of making innovations significantly more impactful.
